name: Parks Closure Status Due to COVID-19: Dog Runs
description:
This dataset records the closure and reopening status of dog runs in New York City parks during the COVID-19 pandemic. Each of the 85 rows represents one dog run, identified by name, property name, park district, and borough (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, or Staten Island). The data includes the closure type (all records show "Completely Locked"), current status (mostly "Reopened," with a few "UnderConstruction" or still "COVID-19 Closure"), approximate closure and reopening dates, and whether red signage was installed or yellow signage removed. Geographic boundary data is provided as polygon coordinates for each site, along with internal park identifiers and edit timestamps.

The dataset could be used to examine how dog run closures varied across boroughs and park districts, analyze the timing and duration of shutdowns, or map the locations of affected facilities.
